title: Customer Insights - Journeys: Journey Creation Agent builds journeys from a plain-language description
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap dates, preview qualifications, enablement requirements, licensing and documented controls are supported. Both API calls flagged by the pre-check are valid; the page distinguishes general credit-management behaviour from an unverified feature-specific spending guarantee.

claims.claim: A feature-specific number of Copilot credits per journey creation is not published in the documentation checked.
claims.quote: Searched: "Journey Creation Agent" "credits" "rate". Opened journey-creation-agent, faqs-journey-creation-agent, ai-hub-prerequisites and pay-as-you-go-meters; the meter publishes $0.01 per credit, not a fixed credit count per journey.

claims.claim: Copilot Studio capacity is allocated to the Customer Insights - Journeys environment in the Power Platform admin center.
claims.quote: Before using AI agents, administrators need to make sure enough Copilot Studio capacity is allocated to the environment. Capacity allocation is managed in the Power Platform Admin Center.

claims.claim: AI Hub instructs administrators to configure message consumption limits to control Journey Creation Agent usage.
claims.quote: To control agent usage, configure message consumption limits. For more information, see Manage capacity.

claims.claim: The allocation tutorial describes tenant-pool draw as allowing use of unallocated tenant capacity after an environment's allocation is exhausted.
claims.quote: when it's enabled, the environment continues to draw from unallocated tenant capacity after its own allocation is exhausted; when it's disabled, the environment is capped at its allocation

claims.claim: Bill to my pay-as-you-go billing plan is a separate overage source.
claims.quote: Select Bill to my pay-as-you-go billing plan to let the environment continue usage through the selected billing plan.

claims.claim: With no overage source enabled, the environment can consume only its allocated prepaid credits.
claims.quote: If no overage source is enabled, the environment can consume only its allocated prepaid credits. Experiences that require credits can stop working after that allocation is exhausted.

claims.where: controls[2].note; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn does not give a Journey Creation Agent-specific guarantee that the tenant-pool draw setting by itself caps this agent's spend.
claims.quote: Searched: "Journey Creation Agent" "Draw from" "cap". Opened AI Hub, its prerequisites, the allocation tutorial and capacity-management page; allocation guidance is linked, but no feature-specific spending guarantee is stated and PAYG is a separate overage route.

claims.claim: The cited prerequisites and data-movement pages state no separate cost for allowing cross-region data movement.
claims.quote: Searched the opened ai-hub-prerequisites and geographical-availability-copilot pages for the cost of Move data across regions; they give prerequisites, consent and processing terms, not a separate charge for the setting.

claims.claim: The cited Anthropic enablement pages state no separate cost for allowing the provider.
claims.quote: Searched the opened connect-to-ai-subprocessor and allow-llm-generative-responses pages for the cost of allowing Anthropic; neither states a separate charge for enabling the provider.

claims.claim: The documented Power Platform route is Copilot > Settings > Dynamics 365 Customer Insights – Journeys > AI agents > Use AI agents.
claims.quote: Go to Power Platform Admin Center > Copilot > Settings. ... Scroll to the Dynamics 365 Customer Insights – Journeys section. ... Select AI agents. ... Set Use AI agents to On for the selected environment or environment group.

claims.claim: No automation operation was found for the Customer Insights - Journeys Use AI agents setting.
claims.quote: Searched: "Use AI agents" "Customer Insights" API PowerShell pac admin; "Customer Insights" "AI agents" "Power Platform API" enable. Opened AI Hub and read Power Platform API/environment-management search excerpts; no operation for this switch.

claims.claim: The agent is enabled through Customer Insights - Journeys > Settings > AI Hub > Add and manage agents > Add an agent > Journey Creation Agent > Overview tab > Enable.
claims.quote: To open AI Hub, go to Settings and select AI Hub ... In AI Hub, select Add and manage agents. ... Select Add an agent and choose Journey Creation Agent. ... In the Overview tab ... To activate the agent, select Enable.

claims.claim: No documented automation operation was found for enabling this agent in AI Hub.
claims.quote: Searched: "msdynmkt_agentsettings" "Web API" enable Journey Creation Agent; "msdynmkt_agentsettings" table entity reference enable. Opened AI Hub; search returned msdyn_agentsetting, a different table, not a documented enablement operation for this agent.

claims.claim: Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits > environment reaches the environment's allocation and overage pane.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select Licensing. ... Under Products, select Copilot Studio, and then select Manage Copilot Credits. ... Select the environment that you want to manage.

claims.claim: PUT /licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01 writes the allocation, with MCSMessages, allocation.quantity and a TenantPool enforcement rule in the body.
claims.quote: $apiVersion = "2024-10-01" ... entitlementId = "MCSMessages" ... allocation = @{ quantity = 5000 } ... @{ ruleType = "TenantPool"; enabled = $false } ... Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put ... "$apiBaseUrl/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=$apiVersion"

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 Anthropic opt-in path is Copilot > Settings > View all > AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors > Available subprocessors for your organization > Anthropic.
claims.quote: select Copilot > Settings > View all. ... Select AI providers operating as Microsoft subprocessors. ... under Available subprocessors for your organization, select Anthropic

claims.claim: No documented Microsoft Graph or other automation operation was found for the Microsoft 365 Anthropic provider setting.
claims.quote: Searched: Anthropic provider subprocessor enable settings Microsoft Graph API Power Platform PowerShell; site:learn.microsoft.com/graph "Anthropic" "subprocessor". Opened connect-to-ai-subprocessor; results document UI settings, not a provider-setting API.

claims.claim: Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features reaches the model-provider switches, which can be turned On or Off.
claims.quote: select Manage. ... select Environments, and then select the environment. ... select Settings. ... select Product > Features. ... On the Features page, turn each applicable model provider setting On or Off.

claims.claim: No documented automation operation was found for allowing Anthropic models in a Power Platform environment.
claims.quote: Searched: "Power Platform Anthropic" "API" "settings"; site:learn.microsoft.com "Anthropic" "Set-" "environment". Opened allow-llm-generative-responses and searched organization reference; no documented property or operation for this provider switch.

claims.claim: The Power Platform Anthropic environment group rule controls Anthropic model availability across a group.
claims.quote: If an environment is part of an environment group, use environment group rules to manage external models across the group. ... Power Platform Anthropic | Controls Power Platform Anthropic models.

claims.claim: Manage > Environments > environment > Generative AI features > Edit > Move data across regions is the documented consent route.
claims.quote: select Manage. ... Select Environments. ... select the target environment. ... locate the Generative AI features card and select Edit. ... Select the Move data across regions checkbox.

claims.claim: Microsoft.PowerApps.Administration.PowerShell provides Set-PowerPlatformGenerativeAiSettings -EnvironmentName <environment-id> -CrossGeoDataMovement $true.
claims.quote: Module: Microsoft.PowerApps.Administration.PowerShell ... -EnvironmentName: Specifies the ID of the environment you want to modify. ... -CrossGeoDataMovement: Enables or disables cross-geo data movement.

claims.claim: The platform page says the data-movement checkbox is not displayed for environments in U.S. or government cloud regions.
claims.quote: The Move data across regions checkbox isn't displayed for environments in U.S. or government cloud regions.

claims.claim: The prerequisites page gives Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features > AI Builder > AI prompts.
claims.quote: select Environments > [select an environment] > Settings > Product > Features. ... On the Features settings page under AI Builder, enable the AI prompts toggle.

claims.claim: PATCH <organization-uri>/api/data/v9.2/organizations(<organization-id>) can set the Boolean aipromptsenabled property to enable AI prompts.
claims.quote: Entity set path: [organization URI]/api/data/v9.2/organizations ... Primary key: organizationid ... Operations supported: GETPATCH ... aipromptsenabled | Edm.Boolean | Indicates whether AI Prompts feature is enabled.

claims.claim: An environment group rule can govern AI prompts availability.
claims.quote: If your environment is part of an environment group, you can also govern the AI prompts feature availability through the AI prompts environment group rule.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated how general availability in April CY2027 will change tenant defaults or the enablement steps.
claims.quote: Searched: "Journey Creation Agent" "general availability" default. Read the roadmap, journey-creation-agent, AI Hub and FAQ; the roadmap supplies a target and Learn describes preview enablement, not a general availability default or migration.

claims.claim: Power Platform Administrator or Global Administrator can manage the credit allocations.
claims.quote: Sign in as a user with the Power Platform Administrator or Global Administrator role, or an equivalent role that can manage licensing and capacity.

claims.claim: The documentation links to Microsoft's product availability reports for geographical availability.
claims.quote: AI agents in Customer Insights - Journeys are available in the geographical regions listed in Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and Copilot Studio product availability.

claims.claim: The marketer publishes the completed journey using the usual journey publication process.
claims.quote: When the journey structure is correct, you can publish the journey as you usually would.

claims.claim: The preview documentation and its described limits are subject to change.
claims.quote: [This article is prerelease documentation and is subject to change.]

claims.claim: Administrators can monitor environment credit consumption in the Power Platform admin center.
claims.quote: The Environments tab provides details on the Copilot Studio credit capacity consumed per environment, including the number of Copilot Credits deducted from the prepaid capacity and the units billed under pay-as-you-go plans.
